name: claim-promos
title: Claim Fab's Limited Time Free assets
summary: Find paid listings that are 100% off right now and claim them through checkout at a total of 0

steps.why: List the current promos (the fab.com/limited-time-free page); is_free=1 misses them
steps.check: show the rows with owned:false and ask the user before claiming

steps.why: Run Fab's checkout at a total of 0 for each, in one hidden window; claim and claim-batch refuse promos
steps.check: results[]: claimed (with orderId), already_owned, not_promo, non_zero_total (refused, nothing ordered); meta counts

on_error.auth_required: Run fabcli auth login, then re-run; claimed ones answer already_owned

notes: An order is placed only when Epic's checkout total is exactly 0; anything else is refused before ordering.
If hCaptcha wants a challenge, the window appears and stderr says so: tell the user to solve it.
cart_not_empty means the user's own Fab cart has items: they empty it on fab.com, then re-run.
Needs a desktop session; takes about 20 s per asset. To claim only some, use claim-promo-batch --uids a,b,c.
